# Profile snapshot. Test fixture, not the CV.

This file stands in for the CV until the real one lands in config/profile/. It
is a factual career summary only, used by the scorer as capability evidence.
Drop cv.txt or cv.pdf into config/profile/ and the scripts use that instead.

Luke Keogh. Software leader in regulated industries since 2011. Based near
Chichester, West Sussex. Engaged through LKEOGH QA Ltd, a UK consultancy
trading since 2015.

Current role. Software Director at Axithra, a Belgian imec and Ghent University
spin-off building a Raman-on-chip therapeutic drug monitoring platform, a
Class C IVD under IEC 62304.

Previous. Software Director at miDiagnostics, where he oversaw FDA clearance
for a Class B IVD and an EU IVDR submission for a Class C IVD under IEC 62304.
Earlier career in defence and aerospace at Fujitsu and L3Harris, including RAF
and Royal Navy programmes and air traffic control, plus utilities work with
SSE.

Standards. IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 81001-5-1, FDA 524B awareness,
EU MDR and IVDR pathways.

Toolchain. SpiraPlan and regulated ALM configuration. Comfortable with n8n,
Docker, Proxmox and self-hosting.

Service lines. A software testing practice under LKeoghQA, and a senior
leadership offer of fractional or interim software director roles for medical
device and IVD companies, delivered personally. A fixed scope IEC 62304 gap
assessment is the productised front door.

In progress. CQI-IRCA ISO 13485 Lead Auditor course planned for late autumn
2026. PRRC qualification before year end. ISO 27001 Lead Auditor after that.
RAC Devices targeted for spring 2027.
